== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Script consists of patterns or symbols used to manipulate [[vital aura]]. Rather than being a celestial language, it functions as a series of shapes that guide and reshape [[aura]] to achieve specific purposes. These patterns can be etched into various surfaces, including wood, dirt, [[stone]], glass, and fabric, or even embedded in objects like cloth. When a user provides [[madra]] to a script, it activates, often producing light or other physical effects. [[scripts|Scripts]] serve many roles, such as creating protective wards, generating light, or acting as control arrays. They can be used to catch and eject energy, hide individuals from spiritual senses, or activate the abilities of [[binding|bindings]] and [[constructs]]. While a script is essentially a two-dimensional drawing of symbols, it can be used to trigger more complex, three-dimensional phenomena like [[binding|bindings]]. The effectiveness and stability of a script depend on its complexity, the medium it is written upon, and the amount of energy used to power it.}}
